keyPoints.en: Tempo: largo, adagio, andante, moderato, allegro, presto; accelerando (faster), ritardando (slower).
keyPoints.bm: Tempo: largo, adagio, andante, moderato, allegro, presto; accelerando (beransur cepat), ritardando (beransur perlahan).

keyPoints.en: Dynamics: pp, p, mp, mf, f, ff; crescendo (louder), diminuendo (softer).
keyPoints.bm: Dinamik: pp, p, mp, mf, f, ff; crescendo (beransur kuat), diminuendo (beransur lembut).
Pic = tinggi/rendah; warna ton = kualiti bunyi.

keyPoints.en: Texture: monophonic (one line), homophonic (melody + chords), polyphonic (several melodies).
keyPoints.bm: Tekstur: monofoni (satu garisan), homofoni (melodi + kord), polifoni (beberapa melodi).

keyPoints.en: Binary AB, ternary ABA, rondo ABACA.
keyPoints.bm: Binari AB, ternari ABA, rondo ABACA.

tip.en: Label sections with letters as you listen.
tip.bm: Labelkan bahagian dengan huruf semasa mendengar.
